canonical_database.scope: 72 completed series, 174 games, source-reported scoreboard and schedule data

transcript_segments.scope: 27 bounded segment ledgers with raw line and cue ranges

pilot_ledger.scope: 3 pilot series (1036, 1037, 1107); claim-level observations, insights and audits
still_authoritative_for: pilot insight and audit records INS-*, AUD-*
1037 semantic evidence, which has no transcript source
the 8 pilot segments and their visual/database references

visual_reviews.scope: DeepSeek-only frame and boundary reviews; 0 visually verified

id_conventions.policy: Do not rename existing IDs. The variant is schema-valid (prefix TOBS-) and is referenced from Markdown; new records must use the canonical form.

reconciliation.decision: Staging transcript ledgers are the canonical store for new broadcast observations. The pilot ledger is frozen and remains authoritative only for the 3 pilot analyses and for 1037, which has no transcript source.
reconciliation.alias_policy: No automatic aliasing: pilot observations are claim-level and transcript observations are quote-level, so a one-to-one alias would be false precision. References stay store-qualified.

rules: New transcript observations go to analysis/evidence/transcript-observations/ and must pass tools/validate_transcript_ledger.py.
Never append new records to analysis/evidence/pilot-ledger.jsonl.
Cite pilot records as pilot-store records; cite transcript records by TOBS id.
Statistics always come from tools/stats_query.py with query_id and snapshot hash.
Visual claims come only from the DeepSeek visual ledger and require a same-frame literal 00:00.
